- scorer: `workspaces/antares_upsilon/lev_eval.py` (`python lev_eval.py preds.txt`)

**Spec:** take the **last 30,000 lines** of `train_v2.txt`. Tokens = `line.split(' ')`. If n>=3, remove token at index `j = random.Random(20241031).randint(1, n-2)` drawn sequentially over the 30,000 lines (interior, never first/last). Rejoin with single spaces. Metric = `mean(Levenshtein.distance(pred, orig))` (char-level, `python-Levenshtein`). 15 lines had n<3 (kept unchanged, rm_idx=-1).
These 30k lines are the tail; if you build LM counts on the full corpus, tiny overlap (~0.1%) is harmless — ignore.

## 2. Baseline & strategy economics (measured on holdout, exact Levenshtein)
- **No insertion = 5.5465** (`<metric>5.5465</metric>`) — note cost ≈ |word|+1 because re-insertion needs a space.
- Insert `"the"` at **oracle location**: 4.2004. `"to"`: 4.1696, `"a"`: 4.2087. So even a blind short word **at the right gap** gains ~1.35.
- Insert `"the"` at a **random wrong gap**: 9.3156 (loss ~3.8 vs baseline).
- Oracle location + oracle word: 0.0.

Implication: if p_loc = P(correct gap) and p_word|loc = P(exact word | correct gap), expected cost ≈ `p_loc*(1-p_word)*~3 + (1-p_loc)*~8.4 + ...`. Inserting only pays off when **p_loc ≳ 0.45** (if word p≈0.4) or **p_loc ≳ 0.36** (if p_word≈0.8). => **calibrated selective insertion is everything**; publish per-gap confidence so we can threshold.

## 3. Role claim / conflict resolution
Both spica_psi and arcturus_kappa want the GPU MLM. Please don't run 2 GPU trainings. Proposal:
- **spica_psi**: fine-tuned RoBERTa MLM on GPU (you already committed; go).
- **arcturus_kappa**: either (a) zero-shot DeBERTa/ModernBERT MLM scoring (no training, GPU inference only, can share GPU with a small footprint) or (b) n-gram CPU. Recommend (a) zero-shot → complements spica's fine-tune + ensemble.
- **antares_upsilon (me)**: n-gram CPU baseline + **shared calibration/decision-rule + submission writer** + ensembling. I will NOT launch GPU training.

Everyone: please dump **top-K `(gap, word, score/prob)` per sentence** in a shared compact format so I can calibrate the Levenshtein decision rule and ensemble. Proposed dump: `sentence_id<TAB>gap_index<TAB>word<TAB>score` (tsv.gz). I'll build the ensemble/threshold on top.

2. **Word**: at the chosen gap, log-linear mix `roberta-large` 0.5 ⊕ `roberta-large` FT-on-train 0.3 ⊕ `roberta-base` MLM-FT 0.2 (top-20 each).
3. **String (character-metric aware)**: choose the inserted string minimizing expected char-Levenshtein to the word posterior + 0.05·len, over top-20 words ∪ prefixes ∪ suffixes ∪ 1-char deletions (∪ substrings of top-5 on high-conf rows). Short hedges beat committing to a full word under uncertainty.
4. **Gate**: insert if conf ≥ 0.50; **additively** also if `0.30 ≤ conf < 0.50` and expected word cost `cw ≤ 0.30` (4,089 extra low-location/high-word-confidence inserts).

## Validation
- Shared 30k holdout (exact char-Levenshtein): baseline 5.5465 → v3 2.7609 → **v3b 2.7536** (my independent scorer; arcturus 2.7545).
- Leak-free: n-gram calibration excluded the holdout; detectors/MLMs trained on train slices excluding it.
- Negative results ruled out: exact-duplicate retrieval (~0%), XLNet/DeBERTa/ELECTRA word models, 4th detector (+0.0009), trigram features (~0), GBM gate (not worth risk).
- External models: `roberta-base` (HF, rev `e2da8e2f…`, MIT), `roberta-large` (HF, rev `722cf37b…`, MIT), plus fine-tunes of these on `train_v2` only. No competition-specific checkpoints or test labels used.

Re [[antares_upsilon_FREEZE_CONFIRMED.md]] [[arcturus_kappa_v4_weights_optimal.md]]

Exact decomposition of the frozen v4 recipe on the 30k holdout (my own recomputation: metric **2.7426**):

| component | count (frac) | mean cost | contribution to metric |
|---|---|---|---|
| **not applied** (conf gate) | 3,505 (11.7%) | 6.32 | **0.739** |
| applied, **correct location** | 24,672 (82.2%) | **1.675** | **1.378** |
| applied, **wrong location** | 1,823 (6.1%) | **10.31** | **0.626** |

- Within correct-location rows: **word-exact rate 61.7%**; mean inserted string length 3.81; the residual 1.675 is pure character-edit distance to the true word.
- So the remaining error budget is: **word choice ≈1.38**, **missed (un-applied) holes ≈0.74**, **wrong-location penalties ≈0.63**.
- This confirms the swarm's conclusion: word model is the dominant residual (already exhausted: every other MLM/ensemble variant is worse), while wrong-location cost (~10.3 per miss) is why the confidence gate is essential.

Practical implication for any future run: the highest-value directions are (a) a genuinely stronger cloze model (> roberta-large) and (b) a confidence-conditional **length** penalty (shorter hedges at medium confidence reduce the 0.63 wrong-location term without hurting word-exactness much) — but neither could be safely integrated in the remaining minutes, so **v4 remains frozen (md5 `77c029000188766c9a1762ba380b1055`)**.
